title: Smoothness of a base-changed algebra map is realised at a finite stage of the colimit
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a base-changed map of algebras is smooth and the source is of finite presentation, then the base-changed map is smooth already at some stage of the colimit (statement lines 47882-47893). The proof does not use a general limit argument for smooth maps: it writes the presentation, recalls that smoothness amounts to a splitting of the differential of the presentation, and then descends the finitely many witnessing elements together with their relations to one index, using commutation of tensor products with directed colimits (proof lines 47895-47920). Spotting that smoothness here is finitely many equations is the step that makes the descent possible, and the author writes the whole argument out. H2.
